Set Implicit Arguments.

From TLC Require Import LibLN.

Require Import Main_ott Main_Infra.

Implicit Types x : var.

Implicit Types G : env.

Fixpoint remove_anno (e : trm) {struct e} : trm :=
  match e with
  | trm_var_b i        => trm_var_b i
  | trm_var_f x        => trm_var_f x
  | trm_star          => trm_star
  | trm_top           => trm_top
  | trm_app t1 t2     => trm_app (remove_anno t1) (remove_anno t2)
  | trm_abs t0 t1 t2  => trm_abs (remove_anno t0) (remove_anno t1) (remove_anno t2)
  | trm_prod t0 t1 t2 => trm_prod (remove_anno t0) (remove_anno t1) (remove_anno t2)
  | trm_castup t1 t2  => trm_castup (remove_anno t1) (remove_anno t2)
  | trm_castdn t1     => trm_castdn (remove_anno t1)
  | trm_anno t1 t2    => remove_anno t1
  end.

Notation "[# e #]" := (remove_anno e) (at level 2).

Definition rem_anno_env (p:binding) :=
  match p with
  | bind_sub e A => bind_sub (remove_anno e) (remove_anno A)
  end.

Notation "{# E #}" := (map rem_anno_env E) (at level 2).

Inductive dsub : env -> trm -> trm -> Prop :=
  | dsub_star : forall G, ok G -> dsub G trm_star trm_star
  | dsub_var_refl : forall G x e A,
      ok G -> binds x (bind_sub e A) G -> dsub G (trm_var_f x) (trm_var_f x)
  | dsub_var_trans : forall e1 A G x e2,
      binds x (bind_sub e1 A) G -> dsub G e1 e2 ->
      dsub G (trm_var_f x) e2
  | dsub_top : forall G e,
      ok G -> lc_trm e -> dsub G e trm_top
  | dsub_lam : forall L G e1 e2 e3 A,
      ok G ->
      (forall x, x \notin L -> dsub (G & x ~ bind_sub [#e3#] [#A#]) (e1 ^ x) (e2 ^ x)) ->
      dsub G (trm_abs e3 A e1) (trm_abs e3 A e2)
  | dsub_app : forall G e1 e2 A,
      lc_trm A ->
      dsub G e1 e2 -> dsub G (trm_app e1 A) (trm_app e2 A)
  | dsub_pi : forall L G e A B C D,
      dsub G C A ->
      (forall x, x \notin L -> dsub (G & x ~ bind_sub [#e#] [#C#]) (B ^ x) (D ^ x)) ->
      dsub G (trm_prod e A B) (trm_prod e C D)
  | dsub_castup : forall G A e1 e2,
      lc_trm A -> dsub G e1 e2 -> dsub G (trm_castup A e1) (trm_castup A e2)
  | dsub_castdn : forall G e1 e2,
      dsub G e1 e2 -> dsub G (trm_castdn e1) (trm_castdn e2).

Inductive dir := inf | chk.

Inductive dtyping : dir -> env -> trm -> trm -> Prop :=
  | dtyping_star : forall G,
      dwf G -> dtyping inf G trm_star trm_star
  | dtyping_var : forall e G x A,
      dwf G -> binds x (bind_sub e A) G -> dtyping inf G (trm_var_f x) A
  | dtyping_top : forall G A,
      dtyping chk G A trm_star -> dtyping chk G trm_top A
  | dtyping_lam : forall L G e1 e2 A B,
      dtyping chk G e1 [#A#] ->
      dtyping chk G A trm_star ->
      (forall x, x \notin L ->
                 dtyping inf (G & x ~ bind_sub [#e1#] [#A#]) (e2 ^ x) (B ^ x)) ->
      dtyping inf G (trm_abs e1 A e2) (trm_prod [#e1#] [#A#] B)
  | dtyping_app : forall e3 G e A B C,
      dtyping chk G A B ->
      dsub G [#A#] e3 ->
      dtyping inf G e (trm_prod e3 B C) ->
      dtyping inf G (trm_app e A) (C ^^ [#A#])
  | dtyping_pi : forall L G e A B,
      dtyping chk G e [#A#] ->
      dtyping chk G A trm_star ->
      (forall x, x \notin L ->
        dtyping chk (G & x ~ bind_sub [#e#] [#A#]) (B ^ x) trm_star) ->
      dtyping inf G (trm_prod e A B) trm_star
  | dtyping_castup : forall G e A B,
      dtyping chk G B trm_star ->
      dtyping inf G e A ->
      reduct [#B#] [#A#] ->
      dtyping inf G (trm_castup B e) [#B#]
  | dtyping_castdn : forall G e A B,
      dtyping chk G B trm_star ->
      dtyping inf G e A ->
      reduct [#A#] [#B#] ->
      dtyping chk G (trm_castdn e) B
  | dtyping_anno : forall G e A,
      dtyping chk G e A ->
      dtyping chk G A trm_star ->
      dtyping inf G (trm_anno e A) [#A#]
  | dtyping_sub : forall A G e B,
      dtyping inf G e A ->
      dsub G A [#B#] ->
      dtyping chk G B trm_star ->
      dtyping chk G e B
  | dtyping_chk : forall G e A,
      dtyping inf G e A ->
      dtyping chk G e A

with dwf : env -> Prop :=
  | dwf_nil : dwf empty
  | dwf_cons : forall G x e A,
      x # G ->
      dtyping chk G e [#A#] ->
      dtyping chk G A trm_star ->
      dwf (G & x ~ bind_sub [#e#] [#A#]).

Theorem sub_to_bidir : forall G e1 e2 A,
  sub G e1 e2 A ->
  dsub G e1 e2 /\
  exists e1' e2',
    dtyping inf G e1' A /\ dtyping inf G e2' A /\
    [#e1'#] = e1 /\ [#e2'#] = e2.

Theorem bidir_to_sub : forall G d e1 e2 A,
  dtyping d G e1 A ->
  dtyping d G e2 A ->
  dsub G e1 e2 ->
  sub {#G#} [#e1#] [#e2#] [#A#].

20	Fixpoint open_trm_wrt_trm_rec (k:nat) (e_5:trm) (e__6:trm) {struct e__6}: trm :=
21	  match e__6 with
22	  | (trm_var_b nat) => If (k = nat) then e_5 else (trm_var_b nat)
23	  | (trm_var_f x5) => trm_var_f x5
24	  | trm_star => trm_star
25	  | trm_top => trm_top
26	  | (trm_app e1 e2) => trm_app (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e1) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e2)
27	  | (trm_abs e1 A e2) => trm_abs (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e1) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 A) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec (S k) e_5 e2)
28	  | (trm_prod e A B) => trm_prod (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 A) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec (S k) e_5 B)
29	  | (trm_castup A e) => trm_castup (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 A) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e)
30	  | (trm_castdn e) => trm_castdn (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e)
31	  | (trm_anno e A) => trm_anno (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 A)

34	Definition open_binding_wrt_trm_rec (k:nat) (e5:trm) (b5:binding) : binding :=

37	end.

39	Definition open_binding_wrt_trm e5 b5 := open_binding_wrt_trm_rec 0 b5 e5.

41	Definition open_trm_wrt_trm e_5 e__6 := open_trm_wrt_trm_rec 0 e__6 e_5.
42	
43	Inductive lc_trm : trm -> Prop :=
44	 | lc_trm_var_f : forall (x5:var),
45	     (lc_trm (trm_var_f x5))
46	 | lc_trm_star :
47	     (lc_trm trm_star)
48	 | lc_trm_top :
49	     (lc_trm trm_top)
50	 | lc_trm_app : forall (e1 e2:trm),
51	     (lc_trm e1) ->
52	     (lc_trm e2) ->
53	     (lc_trm (trm_app e1 e2))
54	 | lc_trm_abs : forall (L:vars) (e1 A e2:trm),

57	      ( forall x5 , x5 \notin  L  -> lc_trm  ( open_trm_wrt_trm e2 (trm_var_f x5) )  )  ->
58	     (lc_trm (trm_abs e1 A e2))
59	 | lc_trm_prod : forall (L:vars) (e A B:trm),
60	     (lc_trm e) ->

63	     (lc_trm (trm_prod e A B))

65	     (lc_trm A) ->
66	     (lc_trm e) ->
67	     (lc_trm (trm_castup A e))
68	 | lc_trm_castdn : forall (e:trm),
69	     (lc_trm e) ->
70	     (lc_trm (trm_castdn e))

72	     (lc_trm e) ->
73	     (lc_trm A) ->
74	     (lc_trm (trm_anno e A)).

From TLC Require Import LibLN.

Inductive trm : Set :=
 | trm_var_b (_:nat)
 | trm_var_f (x5:var)
 | trm_star : trm
 | trm_top : trm
 | trm_app (e1:trm) (e2:trm)
 | trm_abs (e1:trm) (A:trm) (e2:trm)
 | trm_prod (e:trm) (A:trm) (B:trm)
 | trm_castup (A:trm) (e:trm)
 | trm_castdn (e:trm)
 | trm_anno (e:trm) (A:trm)  .

Inductive binding : Set :=
 | bind_sub (e:trm) (A:trm)  .

Definition env := LibEnv.env binding.

Fixpoint open_trm_wrt_trm_rec (k:nat) (e_5:trm) (e__6:trm) {struct e__6}: trm :=
  match e__6 with
  | (trm_var_b nat) => If (k = nat) then e_5 else (trm_var_b nat)
  | (trm_var_f x5) => trm_var_f x5
  | trm_star => trm_star
  | trm_top => trm_top
  | (trm_app e1 e2) => trm_app (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e1) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e2)
  | (trm_abs e1 A e2) => trm_abs (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e1) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 A) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec (S k) e_5 e2)
  | (trm_prod e A B) => trm_prod (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 A) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec (S k) e_5 B)
  | (trm_castup A e) => trm_castup (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 A) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e)
  | (trm_castdn e) => trm_castdn (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e)
  | (trm_anno e A) => trm_anno (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 e) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e_5 A)
end.

Definition open_binding_wrt_trm_rec (k:nat) (e5:trm) (b5:binding) : binding :=
  match b5 with
  | (bind_sub e A) => bind_sub (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e5 e) (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k e5 A)
end.

Definition open_binding_wrt_trm e5 b5 := open_binding_wrt_trm_rec 0 b5 e5.

Definition open_trm_wrt_trm e_5 e__6 := open_trm_wrt_trm_rec 0 e__6 e_5.

Inductive lc_trm : trm -> Prop :=
 | lc_trm_var_f : forall (x5:var),
     (lc_trm (trm_var_f x5))
 | lc_trm_star :
     (lc_trm trm_star)
 | lc_trm_top :
     (lc_trm trm_top)
 | lc_trm_app : forall (e1 e2:trm),
     (lc_trm e1) ->
     (lc_trm e2) ->
     (lc_trm (trm_app e1 e2))
 | lc_trm_abs : forall (L:vars) (e1 A e2:trm),
     (lc_trm e1) ->
     (lc_trm A) ->
      ( forall x5 , x5 \notin  L  -> lc_trm  ( open_trm_wrt_trm e2 (trm_var_f x5) )  )  ->
     (lc_trm (trm_abs e1 A e2))
 | lc_trm_prod : forall (L:vars) (e A B:trm),
     (lc_trm e) ->
     (lc_trm A) ->
      ( forall x5 , x5 \notin  L  -> lc_trm  ( open_trm_wrt_trm B (trm_var_f x5) )  )  ->
     (lc_trm (trm_prod e A B))
 | lc_trm_castup : forall (A e:trm),
     (lc_trm A) ->
     (lc_trm e) ->
     (lc_trm (trm_castup A e))
 | lc_trm_castdn : forall (e:trm),
     (lc_trm e) ->
     (lc_trm (trm_castdn e))
 | lc_trm_anno : forall (e A:trm),
     (lc_trm e) ->
     (lc_trm A) ->
     (lc_trm (trm_anno e A)).

Inductive lc_binding : binding -> Prop :=
 | lc_bind_sub : forall (e A:trm),
     (lc_trm e) ->
     (lc_trm A) ->
     (lc_binding (bind_sub e A)).

Fixpoint fv_trm (e_5:trm) : vars :=
  match e_5 with
  | (trm_var_b nat) => \{}
  | (trm_var_f x5) => \{x5}
  | trm_star => \{}
  | trm_top => \{}
  | (trm_app e1 e2) => (fv_trm e1) \u (fv_trm e2)
  | (trm_abs e1 A e2) => (fv_trm e1) \u (fv_trm A) \u (fv_trm e2)
  | (trm_prod e A B) => (fv_trm e) \u (fv_trm A) \u (fv_trm B)
  | (trm_castup A e) => (fv_trm A) \u (fv_trm e)
  | (trm_castdn e) => (fv_trm e)
  | (trm_anno e A) => (fv_trm e) \u (fv_trm A)
end.

Definition fv_binding (b5:binding) : vars :=
  match b5 with
  | (bind_sub e A) => (fv_trm e) \u (fv_trm A)
end.

Fixpoint subst_trm (e_5:trm) (y5:var) (e__6:trm) {struct e__6} : trm :=
  match e__6 with
  | (trm_var_b nat) => trm_var_b nat
  | (trm_var_f x5) => (If x5 = y5 then e_5 else (trm_var_f x5))
  | trm_star => trm_star
  | trm_top => trm_top
  | (trm_app e1 e2) => trm_app (subst_trm e_5 y5 e1) (subst_trm e_5 y5 e2)
  | (trm_abs e1 A e2) => trm_abs (subst_trm e_5 y5 e1) (subst_trm e_5 y5 A) (subst_trm e_5 y5 e2)
  | (trm_prod e A B) => trm_prod (subst_trm e_5 y5 e) (subst_trm e_5 y5 A) (subst_trm e_5 y5 B)
  | (trm_castup A e) => trm_castup (subst_trm e_5 y5 A) (subst_trm e_5 y5 e)
  | (trm_castdn e) => trm_castdn (subst_trm e_5 y5 e)
  | (trm_anno e A) => trm_anno (subst_trm e_5 y5 e) (subst_trm e_5 y5 A)
end.

Definition subst_binding (e5:trm) (y5:var) (b5:binding) : binding :=
  match b5 with
  | (bind_sub e A) => bind_sub (subst_trm e5 y5 e) (subst_trm e5 y5 A)
end.

Inductive reduct : trm -> trm -> Prop :=
 | reduct_beta : forall (e3 A e1 e2:trm),
     lc_trm e3 ->
     lc_trm A ->
     lc_trm (trm_abs e3 A e1) ->
     lc_trm e2 ->
     reduct (trm_app  ( (trm_abs e3 A e1) )  e2)  (open_trm_wrt_trm  e1   e2 )
 | reduct_app : forall (e1 e2 e1':trm),
     lc_trm e2 ->
     reduct e1 e1' ->
     reduct (trm_app e1 e2) (trm_app e1' e2)
 | reduct_castdn : forall (e1 e1':trm),
     reduct e1 e1' ->
     reduct (trm_castdn e1) (trm_castdn e1')
 | reduct_castelim : forall (A e:trm),
     lc_trm A ->
     lc_trm e ->
     reduct (trm_castdn  ( (trm_castup A e) ) ) e.

Inductive sub : env -> trm -> trm -> trm -> Prop :=
 | sub_ax : forall (G:env),
     wf G ->
     sub G trm_star trm_star trm_star
 | sub_var_refl : forall (G:env) (x5:var) (A e:trm),
     wf G ->
      binds ( x5 ) ( (bind_sub e A) ) ( G )  ->
     sub G (trm_var_f x5) (trm_var_f x5) A
 | sub_var_trans : forall (G:env) (x5:var) (e2 A e1:trm),
      binds ( x5 ) ( (bind_sub e1 A) ) ( G )  ->
     sub G e1 e2 A ->
     sub G (trm_var_f x5) e2 A
 | sub_top : forall (G:env) (e A:trm),
      sub ( G ) ( e ) ( e ) ( A )  ->
     sub G e trm_top A
 | sub_top_refl : forall (G:env) (A:trm),
      sub ( G ) ( A ) ( A ) ( trm_star )  ->
     sub G trm_top trm_top A
 | sub_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:env) (e1 A e2 e2' B:trm),
      sub ( G ) ( e1 ) ( e1 ) ( A )  ->
      sub ( G ) ( A ) ( A ) ( trm_star )  ->
      ( forall x5 , x5 \notin  L  ->  sub  ( G  &  x5 ~ (bind_sub e1 A) )   ( open_trm_wrt_trm e2 (trm_var_f x5) )   ( open_trm_wrt_trm e2' (trm_var_f x5) )   ( open_trm_wrt_trm B (trm_var_f x5) )   )  ->
      ( forall x5 , x5 \notin  L  ->  sub (  ( G  &  x5 ~ (bind_sub e1 A) )  ) (  ( open_trm_wrt_trm B (trm_var_f x5) )  ) (  ( open_trm_wrt_trm B (trm_var_f x5) )  ) ( trm_star )  )  ->
     sub G  ( (trm_abs e1 A e2) )   ( (trm_abs e1 A e2') )  (trm_prod e1 A B)
 | sub_app : forall (G:env) (e1 A e2 C e3 B:trm),
     sub G e1 e2 (trm_prod e3 B C) ->
     sub G A e3 B ->
     sub G (trm_app e1 A) (trm_app e2 A)  (open_trm_wrt_trm  C   A )
 | sub_prod : forall (L:vars) (G:env) (e A B A' B':trm),
     sub G A' A trm_star ->
      sub ( G ) ( e ) ( e ) ( A' )  ->
      sub ( G ) ( A ) ( A ) ( trm_star )  ->
      ( forall x5 , x5 \notin  L  ->   sub (  ( G  &  x5 ~ (bind_sub e A) )  ) (  ( open_trm_wrt_trm B (trm_var_f x5) )  ) (  ( open_trm_wrt_trm B (trm_var_f x5) )  ) ( trm_star )   )  ->
      ( forall x5 , x5 \notin  L  -> sub  ( G  &  x5 ~ (bind_sub e A') )   ( open_trm_wrt_trm B (trm_var_f x5) )   ( open_trm_wrt_trm B' (trm_var_f x5) )  trm_star )  ->
     sub G  ( (trm_prod e A B) )   ( (trm_prod e A' B') )  trm_star
 | sub_castup : forall (G:env) (B e1 e2 A:trm),
      sub ( G ) ( B ) ( B ) ( trm_star )  ->
     sub G e1 e2 A ->
     reduct B A ->
     sub G (trm_castup B e1) (trm_castup B e2) B
 | sub_castdn : forall (G:env) (e1 e2 B A:trm),
      sub ( G ) ( B ) ( B ) ( trm_star )  ->
     sub G e1 e2 A ->
     reduct A B ->
     sub G (trm_castdn e1) (trm_castdn e2) B
 | sub_sub : forall (G:env) (e1 e2 B A:trm),
     sub G e1 e2 A ->
     sub G A B trm_star ->
     sub G e1 e2 B
with wf : env -> Prop :=
 | wf_nil :
     wf  empty
 | wf_cons : forall (G:env) (x5:var) (e A:trm),
      sub ( G ) ( e ) ( e ) ( A )  ->
      sub ( G ) ( A ) ( A ) ( trm_star )  ->
      ( x5  # ( G ))  ->
     wf  ( G  &  x5 ~ (bind_sub e A) ) .

Inductive ivalue : trm -> Prop :=
 | ivalue_top :
     ivalue trm_top
 | ivalue_var : forall (x5:var),
     ivalue (trm_var_f x5)
 | ivalue_app : forall (e1 e2:trm),
     lc_trm e2 ->
     ivalue e1 ->
     ivalue (trm_app e1 e2)
 | ivalue_castdn : forall (e:trm),
     ivalue e ->
     ivalue (trm_castdn e).

Inductive value : trm -> Prop :=
 | value_star :
     value trm_star
 | value_ivalue : forall (e:trm),
     ivalue e ->
     value e
 | value_abs : forall (e1 A e2:trm),
     lc_trm e1 ->
     lc_trm A ->
     lc_trm (trm_abs e1 A e2) ->
     value (trm_abs e1 A e2)
 | value_prod : forall (e A B:trm),
     lc_trm e ->
     lc_trm A ->
     lc_trm (trm_prod e A B) ->
     value (trm_prod e A B)
 | value_castup : forall (A e:trm),
     lc_trm A ->
     lc_trm e ->
     value (trm_castup A e).

# 168 — Unified typing and subtyping: bidirectional correspondence

## Task

Show that the unified and bidirectional systems correspond in both directions using the given erasure of annotations.

Prove all of the following declarations in `Task.v`:

- `sub_to_bidir`
- `bidir_to_sub`

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.

Lemma open_var_head_not_anno : forall e,
  (forall a b, e <> trm_anno a b) ->
  forall k x a b, open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f x) e <> trm_anno a b.
Proof.

  - destruct (classicT (k = n)); discriminate.
  - exfalso. apply (H t1 t2). reflexivity.

Lemma Et_open_rec_inv : forall k x e, Et (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k (trm_var_f x) e) -> Et e.

  - injection H as H1 H2. simpl. rewrite (IHe1 k0 H1). rewrite (IHe2 k0 H2). reflexivity.

(* ================= basic annotation lemmas ================= *)

Lemma remove_anno_idem : forall e, [# [# e #] #] = [# e #].
Proof.
  induction e; simpl.
  - reflexivity. - reflexivity. - reflexivity. - reflexivity.
  - f_equal; assumption. - f_equal; assumption. - f_equal; assumption.
  - f_equal; assumption. - f_equal; assumption.
  - rewrite IHe1. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma remove_anno_not_anno : forall e a b, [# e #] <> trm_anno a b.
Proof.
  induction e; simpl; intros; try discriminate; auto.
Qed.

Lemma remove_anno_classic : forall (P:Prop) (t1 t2:trm),
  [# match classicT P with left _ => t1 | right _ => t2 end #] =
  match classicT P with left _ => [# t1 #] | right _ => [# t2 #] end.
Proof. intros. destruct (classicT P); reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma remove_anno_open_rec : forall k v e,
  [# open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k v e #] =
  open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k [# v #] [# e #].
Proof.
  intros k v e. revert k v. induction e; intros k0 v0; simpl.
  - rewrite remove_anno_classic. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity. - reflexivity. - reflexivity.
  - f_equal; [ apply IHe1 | apply IHe2 ].
  - f_equal; [ apply IHe1 | apply IHe2 | apply IHe3 ].
  - f_equal; [ apply IHe1 | apply IHe2 | apply IHe3 ].
  - f_equal; [ apply IHe1 | apply IHe2 ].
  - f_equal; apply IHe.
  - rewrite IHe1. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma remove_anno_open : forall e v,
  [# open_trm_wrt_trm e v #] = open_trm_wrt_trm [# e #] [# v #].
Proof. intros. unfold open_trm_wrt_trm. apply remove_anno_open_rec. Qed.

Lemma remove_anno_open_var : forall e x,
  [# open_trm_wrt_trm e (trm_var_f x) #] =
  open_trm_wrt_trm [# e #] (trm_var_f x).
Proof. intros. rewrite remove_anno_open. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma remove_anno_subst : forall v x e,
  [# subst_trm v x e #] = subst_trm [# v #] x [# e #].
Proof.
  intros v x e. revert v x. induction e; intros v0 x0; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite remove_anno_classic. reflexivity.
  - reflexivity. - reflexivity.
  - f_equal; [ apply IHe1 | apply IHe2 ].
  - f_equal; [ apply IHe1 | apply IHe2 | apply IHe3 ].
  - f_equal; [ apply IHe1 | apply IHe2 | apply IHe3 ].
  - f_equal; [ apply IHe1 | apply IHe2 ].
  - f_equal; apply IHe.
  - rewrite IHe1. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------------- locally closed at level n ---------------- *)

Fixpoint lc_rec (n:nat) (e:trm) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | trm_var_b i => i < n
  | trm_var_f _ => True
  | trm_star => True
  | trm_top => True
  | trm_app a b => lc_rec n a /\ lc_rec n b
  | trm_abs a A b => lc_rec n a /\ lc_rec n A /\ lc_rec (S n) b
  | trm_prod a A b => lc_rec n a /\ lc_rec n A /\ lc_rec (S n) b
  | trm_castup A a => lc_rec n A /\ lc_rec n a
  | trm_castdn a => lc_rec n a
  | trm_anno a A => lc_rec n a /\ lc_rec n A
  end.

Lemma lc_rec_mono : forall n m e, n <= m -> lc_rec n e -> lc_rec m e.
Proof.
  intros n m e. revert n m. induction e; intros n0 m0 Le H; simpl in *.
  - lia.
  - auto. - auto. - auto.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply (IHe1 n0 m0 Le H1)|apply (IHe2 n0 m0 Le H2)].
  - destruct H as [H1 [H2 H3]]; split; [apply (IHe1 n0 m0 Le H1)|split;[apply (IHe2 n0 m0 Le H2)|]].
    apply (IHe3 (S n0) (S m0)); [lia|assumption].
  - destruct H as [H1 [H2 H3]]; split; [apply (IHe1 n0 m0 Le H1)|split;[apply (IHe2 n0 m0 Le H2)|]].
    apply (IHe3 (S n0) (S m0)); [lia|assumption].
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply (IHe1 n0 m0 Le H1)|apply (IHe2 n0 m0 Le H2)].
  - apply (IHe n0 m0 Le H).
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply (IHe1 n0 m0 Le H1)|apply (IHe2 n0 m0 Le H2)].
Qed.

Lemma lc_rec_open_var_inv : forall k x e,

Proof.
  intros k x e. revert k x. induction e; intros k0 x0 H; simpl in *.
  - destruct (classicT (k0 = n)) as [Heq|Hneq]; simpl in *; lia.
  - auto. - auto. - auto.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply (IHe1 k0 x0 H1)|apply (IHe2 k0 x0 H2)].
  - destruct H as [H1 [H2 H3]]; split; [apply (IHe1 k0 x0 H1)|split;[apply (IHe2 k0 x0 H2)|]].
    apply (IHe3 (S k0) x0 H3).
  - destruct H as [H1 [H2 H3]]; split; [apply (IHe1 k0 x0 H1)|split;[apply (IHe2 k0 x0 H2)|]].
    apply (IHe3 (S k0) x0 H3).
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply (IHe1 k0 x0 H1)|apply (IHe2 k0 x0 H2)].
  - apply (IHe k0 x0 H).
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply (IHe1 k0 x0 H1)|apply (IHe2 k0 x0 H2)].
Qed.

Lemma lc_rec_open_inv : forall k v e, lc_rec k v -> lc_rec k (open_trm_wrt_trm_rec k v e) -> lc_rec (S k) e.
Proof.
  intros k v e. revert k v. induction e; intros k0 v0 Hv H; simpl in *.

  - destruct H as [H1 [H2 H3]]; split; [apply (IHe1 k0 v0 Hv H1)|split;[apply (IHe2 k0 v0 Hv H2)|]].

  - destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply (IHe1 k0 v0 Hv H1)|apply (IHe2 k0 v0 Hv H2)].

Left-assoc `L \u \{x\} \u \{y\}` and `\{x\} \u \{y\}` compile; the parenthesized form with `(\{x\} \u \{y\})` failed maybe due to `(` directly before `\{`. Weird lexer. Use left-assoc `L \u \{x\} \u \{y\}`. Parsing is left-assoc: (L\u{x})\u{y}. For freshness: x0 ∉ (L\u{x})\u{y}; notin_union_r gives x0∉(L\u{x}) and x0∉{y}; then x0∉L and x0∉{x}. Good; adapt the splits accordingly: first split gives [HxLy, Hx0y]; second split HxLy gives [HxL,Hxx0]. Our code currently: Hx as [HxL Hxy0] where Hxy0 is the *second* conjunct of the parenthesized right-assoc. With left-assoc, Hx = (L\u{x})\u{y}; notin_union_r → [HxLx, Hx0y] (first is L\u{x}, second is {y}). Then split HxLx → [HxL,Hxx0]. So the code should be:
```
apply notin_union_r in Hx as [HxLx Hx0y].
apply notin_union_r in HxLx as [HxL Hxx0].
assert Hx0x from Hxx0.
assert Hx0y' from Hx0y.
```
Let's patch the L' expressions to left-assoc and the splits in lam/pi.

Lemma length_push : forall (G:env) x (v:binding),
  LibList.length (G & x ~ v) = S (LibList.length G).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite concat_def. rewrite LibList.length_app. rewrite single_def.
  rewrite LibList.length_cons. rewrite LibList.length_nil. lia.
Qed.

Lemma dtyping_dwf : forall d G e A, dtyping d G e A -> dwf G.
Proof. intros d G e A H. induction H; eauto using dwf. Qed.

Lemma dwf_ok : forall G, dwf G -> ok G.
Proof.
  intros G x e A Hdwf Hb. remember (LibList.length G) as n eqn:E. revert G E.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros G E H.
  - symmetry in E. apply LibList.length_zero_inv in E. subst G.
    rewrite <- (empty_def binding). apply (ok_empty binding).
